items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I might call him a personal friend, Henry Rush, he was a drummer.

ctx.x: Pills, crippled Pills. We used to call, I never, I didn't know Pills' right name. What's up? Called him Pills, crippled Pills. You played with you? Yeah, I played with him for a long, you know, for the good while together.
What did they call him, Crowback or something? Crowback? Did you ever hear that nickname, Henry Rush?
Covett, Henry Rush, yeah. I might call him a personal friend, Henry Rush, he was a drummer.
